data.content: {"requirements":[{"unit_ids":["U-bd5481-09e9d163"],"source_quote":"The file must reflect the currently applied filters and sorting.","kind":"functional","statement":"The exported Excel file must contain only the rows matching the currently applied filters, in the currently applied sort order."},{"unit_ids":["U-bd5481-fad183b1"],"source_quote":"Clear column headers and consistent date formatting.","kind":"non_functional","statement":"The exported Excel file must have clear column headers and use one consistent date format across all date columns."},{"unit_ids":["U-bd5481-d22b9b6a"],"source_quote":"Filename must include the generation timestamp.","kind":"functional","statement":"The exported Excel file name must include the timestamp of when the file was generated."},{"unit_ids":["U-bd5481-437992f1"],"source_quote":"User-friendly message if there is no data to export.","kind":"frontend","statement":"When there is no data to export, the system must show a message to the user instead of producing an export file; the message text is not specified in the PRD."}]}
